description: This file defines the class 'NationalityMenuConfigurator' which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. Its purpose is to configure menu options related to 'nationality' within the OrangeHRM system's admin menu structure, specifically overriding certain screen settings.

classes.name: NationalityMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu options for nationality-related screens in the admin module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen setting to 'nationality' within the admin menu, as part of menu configuration process.
